entities.summary: Jeanne Georgette Edmée Vaussard was a French tennis player. She who competed in the Olympic Games in 1920 and 1924 and reached the finals of the French Championships in 1924, losing to her compatriot Julie Vlasto, in a version of the tournament that was till then open only to French nationals.
